title: PowerLab · The study hub

objectives.text: Distinguish power at one moment (W) from energy used over time (Wh).
Calculate energy from device power and operating time.
Meet people's needs within both energy and power limits.

sources.title: EIA · Measuring electricity
sources.note: Reference for power and energy units. All device ratings, scenarios, wording and illustrations in this lab are original fictional teaching material. Source reviewed 2026-09-23.

assumptions: Each device draws its stated power for the entire selected hour, and zero when off.
The battery capacity is usable energy; no additional efficiency discount is applied.
The model evaluates requested demand. It does not simulate electrical delivery after a limit is exceeded.
Starting surges, voltage, wiring, temperature and battery aging are outside this lesson.
These are fictional devices for learning, not equipment specifications or installation advice.

scenarios.title: Keep the study hub open
scenarios.brief: A campus study hub needs four hours of backup power. Keep the light and internet on, make time for cooling, and charge a laptop. Build a schedule that meets every need using one limited battery.

devices.name: Desk lamp
devices.purpose: Keep the desk lit for all four hours.

devices.name: Wi-Fi router
devices.purpose: Keep the study hub connected for all four hours.

devices.name: Desk fan
devices.purpose: Provide at least two hours of cooling.

devices.name: Laptop charger
devices.purpose: Charge the laptop for at least one hour.
